item.title: PAUL VALLAS: Extremist Politics Fuel Rise Of Antisemitism
item.description: Antisemitism is unique in human history for its persistence, adaptability, and ability to reinvent itself across millennia. Today, it has evolved into a coordinated political instrument aimed at undermining the moral and institutional foundations of Western civilization.
